int_name: S CHRISTOPHER COLUMBUS BLVD & TASKER ST

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is hostile, featuring a narrow, obstructed sidewalk and extremely faded crosswalk markings on a wide commercial roadway. The lack of dedicated pedestrian signals and the proximity of high-speed traffic create significant risks for people walking.

hazards.name: Obstructed Sidewalk
hazards.description: A signpost is located directly in the middle of the narrow sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to step into the roadway or onto uneven ground.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground on the narrow paved walkway.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk
hazards.description: The crosswalk markings are extremely faded and barely visible, reducing driver awareness of the crossing point.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Protection
hazards.description: The wide roadway lacks any refuge islands or pedestrian-activated signals, leaving pedestrians exposed to traffic for the entire crossing duration.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to increase visibility for approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk to meet ADA standards and relocate the signpost to a dedicated furniture zone to provide a clear walking path.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to reduce the unprotected crossing distance and allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, vehicle-oriented intersection that incorporates an at-grade railroad crossing. While a high-visibility continental crosswalk is present, the environment lacks pedestrian signals and features long crossing distances that increase exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: At-grade railroad crossing
hazards.description: Railroad tracks intersect the pedestrian path and roadway, creating tripping hazards and risk of conflict with trains.
hazards.location_in_image: Middle ground, crossing the roadway horizontally

hazards.name: Excessive crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway width increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic without a refuge.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible to provide safe crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Installation
interventions.description: Install countdown pedestrian signals to provide clear, dedicated crossing phases.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Rail Crossing Safety Enhancements
interventions.description: Improve the pedestrian walkway across the tracks with level surfaces and dedicated warning signals.

result.summary: The environment is a wide, multi-lane commercial arterial with a high degree of pedestrian hostility due to the absence of crossing infrastructure. While sidewalks are present, the lack of marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and refuge islands creates a significant barrier for anyone attempting to cross the expansive roadway.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The roadway is extremely wide with no median or refuge, exposing pedestrians to traffic for a long duration.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signals are visible at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a dedicated phase.

interventions.title: Install High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Mark the intersection with high-visibility ladder crosswalks to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to reduce crossing distance and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signals with countdown timers to improve crossing safety and predictability.

result.summary: This commercial corridor is heavily prioritized for vehicles, featuring a traffic signal but no marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals. Pedestrians are further disadvantaged by a missing sidewalk on the left side and poor pavement conditions on the existing right-side walkway.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalk
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to designate a safe crossing area for pedestrians at this signalized intersection.

hazards.name: Absence of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: The intersection lacks walk/don't-walk signals, forcing pedestrians to guess the timing based on vehicle lights.

hazards.name: Discontinuous sidewalk
hazards.description: The left side of the street lacks a formal sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to walk through a commercial parking lot or on the road shoulder.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a safe, separated path.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at the intersection corners.
